thought.text: PostgreSQL 15 + PostGIS installed. Start the cluster and create the database per the guide:

reasoning_content:
PostgreSQL 15 has already been installed with PostGIS. Next, start the cluster and create the database and user. According to the guide:
- CREATE USER "$DB_INIT_USER" PASSWORD '$DB_INIT_PASSWORD'; (DDL + DCL privileges)
- CREATE USER "$DB_USER" PASSWORD '$DB_PASSWORD'; (DQL + DML privileges)
- CREATE DATABASE "$DB_NAME" OWNER '$DB_INIT_USER';
- CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgis;

The example environment variables: XPLAN_DB_HOSTNAME=xplan-db, XPLAN_DB_PORT=5432, XPLAN_DB_NAME=xplanbox, XPLAN_DB_USER=xplanbox, XPLAN_DB_PASSWORD=xplanbox, XPLAN_DB_INIT_USER=initxplanbox, XPLAN_DB_INIT_PASSWORD=initxplanbox.

Use the following: DB_NAME=xplanbox, DB_USER=xplanbox, DB_INIT_USER=initxplanbox.

Start the cluster with pg_ctlcluster 15 main start.

action.command: pg_ctlcluster 15 main start && su - postgres -c "psql -c \"CREATE USER initxplanbox PASSWORD 'initxplanbox';\" -c \"CREATE USER xplanbox PASSWORD 'xplanbox';\" -c \"CREATE DATABASE xplanbox OWNER initxplanbox;\"" && su - postgres -c "psql -d xplanbox -c 'CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgis;'" && su - postgres -c "psql -d xplanbox -c 'SELECT extname, extversion FROM pg_extension;'"
